integrity: The finite-sample proof uses exact Dirichlet conditioning and one- and two-coordinate exceedance probabilities. Exact rational computation is supplementary and does not establish the universal quantifiers.
scientific_limitations: The exact formulas assume the uniform-simplex spacing law Dirichlet(1,...,1).
The result is pointwise in the normalized-spacing empirical CDF and does not extend as stated to nonuniform parent laws or other Dirichlet shapes.
The complete 1977 article on empirical spacing-distribution goodness-of-fit tests was not available for direct inspection and remains a historical-literature risk.
title: Greenwood's exact covariance profile against the spacing empirical CDF
